whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Palji's Restaurant,

I noticed your restaurant has a strong local presence near Station Road on Fraser Road Area, but your online ordering and customer discovery are missing out due to a lack of a dedicated mobile website.

Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp food ordering, menu showcase, aur table reservation integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/paljis

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Palji's Restaurant Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke restaurant ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp food ordering and a mobile-friendly menu showcase for customers near Fraser Road Area, Patna. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko design direction pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki actual menu items aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
